source: Completed independent read-only review delivered to parent; principal findings plus parent-recomputed counters, not a new trial.

parent_numeric_verification.assurance: Global sequential samples, not exact per-allocation driver attribution; log hashes independently match review.

leading_hypothesis: Explicit residency requests associated with the successful6.26GiB allocation wire roughly the shard and trigger pressure; low process footprint does not bound driver/system effects. Large head upload is a later risk, not demonstrated before guard abort.

flag_semantics.activation: Any presence of GGML_METAL_NO_RESIDENCY disables residency sets in this pinned capable build; unsetting restores default. Configure before device initialization.
flag_semantics.changes: Residency collection/references, explicit add/commit/request and refresh policy.
flag_semantics.does_not_change: Weights, quantization, requested buffers, placement, mmap, shared/private selection, model kernels/algorithm or existing synchronization/lifetime duties.
flag_semantics.limits: May shift pressure to upload/compute and change performance; no capacity/correctness/stability guarantee.

existing_workaround: Pinned source already includes dummy-work workaround for issue25937; no new fix to apply.
recommended_gate: Independent repaired qualification client must first pass CPU review.
Fresh small native and dual DEFAULT controls with unchanged assets/settings.
Candidate changes ONLY laptop RPC worker policy; mini remains default. Observe laptop startup policy false and shared buffers true.
Require completed matched image answers, actual GPU work, normal pressure, finite budgets and cleanup; matching text is not numerical equivalence.
Only then consider separately budgeted full27B load-only candidate with same3,2 split/context8192/image1024/source/model hashes.
prior_both_host_policy_controls_disposit: Exploratory small-image controls remain valid within documented assurance bounds, but changed both hosts and used the older manual client. They do NOT satisfy the newly recommended transport-reviewed, fresh-default, laptop-only isolation gate.
overall_status: NO full27B inference or always-on admission; no pressure weakening or unrelated app termination authorized.
